definitions.coverage: fretted key notes (fret >= 1 from the capo) whose key fret lies inside the window at the onset (row nearest the onset), of rows not lost / of all fretted
definitions.heard: the same over key notes whose conf is not "tab"
definitions.width: hi - lo + 1 over fretted notes whose row is not lost
definitions.places: possible places of each key note pitch, frets 0-17 from the capo, one per string; open strings always allowed; a lost row allows all
definitions.filter: chain-2 notes removed by hand_filter.py (no open string and no fretted place inside the window), split by a key match (onset 50 ms, same pitch)
definitions.scorer: G/loop/tools/handreach/score_e1.py (definitions of the first look unchanged; extended by e1-record)

conditions.v0: the orchestrator one keyframe per song by eye (capo 60 s, standard), no track; nylon none
conditions.dev: the tracker agent (e1-tracker): capo/standard v0 anchors refined on their frame + neck_track.py; nylon 4 keyframes (20, 60, 110, 160 s), track.final2
conditions.alone: blind anchors (Opus 5.5 at max effort, sandboxed) + neck_track.py, no check
conditions.checked: the same after Opus's blind check: corrections applied per margin; nylon re-tracked with the added keyframe
conditions.assisted: the answer keys neck outlines as anchors (wire 0 = the outline nut line, the body end at fret 20.75 on steel, 12.0 on nylon); standard tracked by its per-frame outlines; capo and nylon one static outline (the capo outline nut corners extrapolated off-frame by the key builder)

solver_decision_aid.what: G/loop/tools/solver/solver.py, weights unchanged (fitted on the capo key), window hard, tuning and capo given; gtr-eval tab main (heard)
